texts.preamble: M.Narasimha Swamy vs The State Of A.P., Rep. By P.P. Hyd. on 12 July, 2024 The Honourable Sri Justice K.Surender Criminal Revision Case No.1431 Of 2013 Order:
texts.facts: The case of the Food Inspector who was examined as PW1 is that he went to the premises of petitioner's shop who is the Proprietor of Gopalanath Kiranam. He secured the presence of independent mediator who was examined as PW3 and purchased 1500 grams of green gram dal and sealed the said dal by separating into three equal parts. Proceedings were drafted under Ex.P7. Thereafter, the sample was sent for the purpose of analysis. Analyst report was received informing that the sample contained synthetic colour, as such, it was adulterated. 4. Notice was given by the Food Inspector to the accused and thereafter complaint was filed. 5. The learned Magistrate having examined PWs.1 to 3 of whom PW1 is the Food Inspector, found favour with the prosecution that the item was adulterated. The prosecution also brought on record Exs.P1 to P26. Having gone through the record, the Food Inspector had followed due procedure while sending the samples to the analyst and also it was informed subsequently to the petitioner regarding adulteration found. 6. The Court below concluded that the food item which is green gram dal kept for sale and human consumption, contained synthetic colour which is harmful to the person who consumes it.
